criteria.title: Reserve two pages without frames, then read first bytes and write one page.
criteria.task: Reserve two pages without frames, then read first bytes and write one page.
criteria.purpose: Assess this particular ownership, state, ordering, resource or evidence boundary independently.

knowledge: T56.03 teaching and full parent contract

artifacts: PR-T56-03 learner source/analysis and precise reused-component identities; absent required implementations remain work

reasoning: Reserve two pages without frames, then read first bytes and write one page.
Derive: Each admitted first touch obtains a zero-filled frame before present mapping publication. Reservation is not allocation, and stale allocator contents must never become user-visible.
State pre/postconditions, invariants, resource costs, failure publication and exact evidence limits. Separate ISO C, original model, compiler/ABI, ISA/OS and physical premises.
